tests.name: Search for a product
tests.goal: Find the search input box on the home page, type 'monitor', and press Enter or click the search button to perform the search.

expected.description: The search results list displays products relevant to monitor with visible titles and prices.

tests.name: View product details
preconditions: At least one product is displayed in the catalog
tests.goal: Browse the available products on the page and click on the first product card or product title to view its detail page.

expected.description: The product detail page clearly presents the product title, image, price, description, and an add to cart button.

tests.name: Add product to cart
preconditions: Cart is empty before starting test
tests.goal: From the homepage, find any product, click into its detail page if necessary, and click the 'Add to Cart' button.

expected.description: The page indicates that one item has been added to the shopping cart, and the cart badge count reflects 1.

tests.name: Update cart item quantity
tests.goal: On the cart page, change the quantity of the item in the cart to 2, either by typing 2 into the quantity field or clicking the quantity increment button.

expected.description: The cart displays item quantity updated to 2 and recalculates the line total.

tests.name: Remove item from cart
tests.goal: In the shopping cart, locate the remove button or trash icon for the item and click it to delete the product from the cart.

expected.description: The cart is empty and displays a message indicating there are no items in the cart.
